synopsis: Promoted in the aftermath of Deatholme, Falanaras joins the blood elf retinue answering Kael’thas’s summons alongside Lady Liadrin, senior magister Astalor Bloodsworn, his assistant Selorien Dawnmark, Grand Magister Rommath, and other soldiers and rangers. They sail aboard a refitted Thalassian destroyer left from the Second War. Falanaras recognizes Liadrin as the high priestess he glimpsed during Quel’Thalas’s fall, but he already knows her faith ended when she judged that the Light had abandoned their people; what unsettles him is the severity that survived its loss. Shipboard hunger, routine, and a violent storm reveal the retinue through action, including Astalor’s controlled technical command and Selorien’s practical support. The voyage follows the eastern coast past Zul’Aman, the plague-marked northern lands, the Hinterlands, Arathi, the southern highlands, and Redridge before the company lands covertly in the Swamp of Sorrows. They march west through the Blasted Lands, reach the blood-elf-held Dark Portal route, and cross into Outland.
title: Chapter 7: To the Dark Portal
